text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I see, you usually do your shopping in 
Funabashi... Isn't that quite a trip?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I decided on that when I started living 
on my own. ...Besides, I don't feel at 
home in shops like this."

Oh, could it be you're not very familiar 
with the shops around here?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, leave it to me! I'll 
show you a shop you'll love too♪

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Um, I appreciate the offer. However, 
something you'd buy at a department store 
is...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it! You won't regret 
knowing about the veggies here~."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Vegetables at a department store?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Maruzen! You after the produce market 
too?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Though today I'm just showing her 
around. I'm introducing her to convenient 
shops for living on her own♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see! They sell vegetables at this event 
space twice a month. Locally grown in 
Tokyo, pesticide-free! You should check it 
out sometime.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! ...Thank you very much. I see, so this 
is where the farmers' vegetables are.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"When I can't cook for myself, I go to 
this deli! It makes me so happy when they 
toss in extra goodies sometimes."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I understand. Back in my hometown, 
they'd often give me an extra croquette on 
the house.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The folks in the shopping district 
are so friendly and wonderful♪ Oh yes, 
another place I'd recommend is over there—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, those two are here too. There's an 
old-fashioned bakery around that corner.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Like sweet bread shaped like Mt. Fuji, or 
sponge cake with sweet red bean paste 
inside. They're perfect for when you need 
some comfort.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I love it too. I see... Even those in 
the Central racing scene are like that...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"And lastly, this laundromat! It won't 
hurt to remember this spot! Back in the 
day, I—"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh, sorry! I just suddenly 
remembered! Back when I first started 
living on my own—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Right after I started living by myself, 
my washing machine broke down, so I came 
to the laundromat."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I felt so pathetic, and so helpless...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I just felt like... I was the only one 
having things go so wrong—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But you know, while waiting for the 
laundry to finish, I looked out at the 
shopping street and realized something.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
People rushing by, people with huge bags, 
a dad struggling with his crying little 
one... Everyone's trying so hard, all of 
them...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Everyone feels the same way... If that's 
the case, maybe I can give it my all too.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I... suppose so. There really is no 
difference... anywhere...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Leaving your hometown must be tough. 
Still, I'd be so happy if you could grow 
to like this place little by little.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for today. I'll be sure 
to try out the shop you told me about.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“—So that happened, and as thanks, they 
told me about the trendy spots in 
Funabashi!”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"There are plenty of wonderful things 
about Funabashi as well!" she wrote! Hehe, 
I wonder if she's finally opened up to me 
a little♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-kun, nice idea! 
I'll go invite them right away!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Trainer-chan, nice idea! 
I'll go invite them right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watched with a warm smile as Maruzensky 
ran off full of excitement.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse there is! Hey, wanna go take a 
drive with Tacchan and check it out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made plans for an outing together with a 
very happy-looking Maruzensky.
